column1: # Stage 1: the three free knobs, one batch. Baseline is "chunk 2M t18" (the shipped default).
# Chunk sweep. 18 threads x 2 MiB = 36 MiB of live buffers against 16 + 8 + 8 MB of L2, so the
# pread's bytes are evicted before the parse reads them back. The old sweep that found this
# flat was run on v8, before the loop was fast enough for the re-fetch to show.
# Thread sweep at the shipped chunk. Never swept above 18.
# The two knobs interact through total live footprint, so a few crosses.
# Control: at 8 threads the live footprint is 16 MiB, which already fits. If the chunk effect
# is a cache-capacity effect it has to be much weaker here.
# debug = 1 costs 125 KB of binary to page in. ~21 ms of the 441 is outside main. Commented out
# because it needs a second build tree; to run it, set strip = true in Cargo.toml and
# then uncomment. It did not pay -- see the README's "predicted to work and did not".
